bio.text: Terrisa Bukovinac is a candidate in New Jersey's 9th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running under the "Save Our Babies" slogan against Rep. Nellie Pou and Republican Rosie Pino.

The New Jersey Globe reports that Bukovinac self-describes as a "progressive pro-life atheist" and that Bukovinac and Randall Terry listed an address in Ellendale, Tennessee in their petition filings.

According to the New Jersey Globe, Bukovinac was the only name besides Joe Biden on New Jersey's 2024 Democratic presidential primary ballot, and is married to Randall Terry, founder of Operation Rescue, who filed to run in the 7th District.

sources.title: Husband-and-wife duo from Tennessee will run as pro-life independents for competitive N.J. seats
Pou (D) and Pino (R) are running in New Jersey's 9th Congressional District
